author: Codex documentation author; corrections by DOC-029 source-review author agent (entities)

prerequisites: Seeded entities lab; the reviewer's own fictional Entities and a fixture NDA Contract per role.
scenarios.expected: Our Entity and external Counterparty retain their distinct roles and labels. A Business User cannot use the Member+ Entities destination (Contributor is a removed role); duplicate/invalid input has a clear outcome.
scenarios.actual: Nadia Haddad opened Entities on the Compliance calendar and switched to List. Search entities by name narrowed to one Helix Software GmbH row; Type LLC with Status Active narrowed the table and Clear all restored it. Add entity opened with Status Active; Register saved Legal name, type, Formation jurisdiction, Formed on 2019-03-14, Registration no., Tax ID, Registered agent and Registered address, and the new record's access list named Nadia Haddad (the creator Grant). Registered agent saved on focus change and Status Dormant on selection; both survived a reload and the record still offered Archive, not Restore. Registering the same legal name again created a second, distinct record. Register with an empty Legal name kept the dialog open with "Name the entity — its registered legal name." and created nothing. On a fixture Contract, Our entity kept the chosen Entity after a reload. Create "DOC-029 entities Cedar Supply L 9U3SZ" added it with the only Primary mark; a second Counterparty took Primary through Make primary. The upper-case name of an attached Counterparty offered no Create row and did not re-offer it. "Take <name> off the contract" on the Primary returned the mark to the remaining Counterparty; the removed shared record was still offered (no Create row) when typed in upper case; removing the last one showed "Nobody is recorded on the other side yet.". With the Entity archived, the Contract still showed it as Our entity and another Contract's Our entity choices did not include the archived record; it was then restored.
scenarios.stepsSummarized: 12 recorded steps for this role, all pass
